title: [Global Home - Hero Property Type Popover] Property Portal Clips "Clear / Done" Footer Buttons on 1440×860–900 Desktop Viewports Due to overflow: hidden & Late Flip Threshold
environment: Staging (STAG) · Desktop 1440×900 (MacBook Pro 15"/Desktop standard) & 1440×860–905 · Chrome 145 · en-US (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home)
steps_to_reproduce: Open https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home on a standard 1440×900 Desktop viewport without scrolling (window.scrollY = 0).
Click the 'Property type (optional) · Select property type' field (.gns-home-hero-field-property) in the Hero Request Form.
Observe the bottom footer ('Clear' and 'Done' buttons) of the opened .gns-home-prop-portal dropdown and try scrolling inside the dropdown.
Inspect getBoundingClientRect(), scrollHeight, clientHeight, maxHeight, and computed overflow of .gns-home-prop-portal in F12 DevTools.
actual_result:
- At 1440×900 (scrollY = 0), .gns-home-prop-portal opens downward starting at top: 731px (left: 307px, width: 263px) and clamps inline max-height: 161px (bottom: 892px, clientHeight: 159px) while its content requires scrollHeight: 176px.
- Because .gns-home-prop-portal sets overflow: hidden / overflow-y: hidden and its upward-flip threshold triggers too late (it flips upward at 1440×800 to top: 488px..664px, but fails to flip when remaining space is 121px–161px at 1440×860–900), the bottom 'Clear' and 'Done' buttons (top: 866px, bottom: 899px) extend 7px past the 892px container bottom at 1440×900 (and up to 47px clipped at 1440×860) and cannot be scrolled into view.
expected_result: - Whenever available viewport space below the trigger is less than the portal's required content height (176px + 8px viewport margin = 184px), .gns-home-prop-portal must flip above the trigger (as it already does at 1440×800) or enable overflow-y: auto on its inner list while keeping the 'Clear / Done' footer fully visible.

evidence.console: 0 uncaught JS errors; .gns-home-prop-portal metrics at 1440×900: rect={x:307, y:731, w:263, h:161, bottom:892}, maxHeight='161px', scrollHeight=176, clientHeight=159, overflow='hidden', Done button bottom=899 (clipped by 7px).
evidence.notes: Root Cause (Portal Flip Threshold < Natural Content Height + overflow: hidden): Portal positioner checks a hardcoded minimum flip height (~140–150px) smaller than the actual 176px content height, clamping max-height to (window.innerHeight - triggerBottom - 8) with overflow: hidden.

classification: Confirmed Bug — Desktop UI Popover Clipping Defect
